statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); project_dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.project_dir'); if [ -d "$cwd/.git" ] || git -C "$cwd" rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then branch=$(git -C "$cwd" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo 'detached'); status=$(git -C "$cwd" status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l); git_info=" $branch"; [ "$status" -gt 0 ] && git_info="$git_info *"; else git_info=""; fi; rel_path=$(realpath --relative-to="$project_dir" "$cwd" 2>/dev/null || basename "$cwd"); printf "\033[38;5;209m󰌽\033[0m \033[38;5;130m%s\033[0m \033[38;5;172m📁 %s\033[0m%s" "$model" "$rel_path" "$git_info"
